job_id.description: The exact UUID provided in the Request, used by the Orchestrator to correlate asynchronous responses.

confidence.description: The normalized confidence score. 0.0 = Authentic, 1.0 = Synthetic/Deepfake.

raw_score.description: The unnormalized logit or raw score from the PyTorch model.

latency_ms.description: The exact time in milliseconds the inference took. Used by the Orchestrator for budget planning.

ram_usage_mb.description: The peak system RAM (in Megabytes) consumed. Optional, though critical for Unified Memory architectures like NVIDIA Jetson.

vram_usage_mb.description: The peak GPU memory (in Megabytes) consumed. Optional, as not all detectors utilize a GPU.

evidence.description: Contextual reasoning for the Debate Agent.

claim.description: A human-readable claim (e.g., 'rPPG signal present but highly irregular').
